categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Flaunch Ecosystem
categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: RWAfi
categories.content: Protocols whose core product is DeFi functionality built on top of tokenized real-world assets issued by third parties. Where RWA Protocols handle issuance, these protocols take an already-tokenized asset as input and make it financially productive: separating an asset's yield from its principal, lending against it as collateral, providing or managing its liquidity, constructing baskets from it, or routing value into it. Protocols in this category represent a claim on protocol activity and are not themselves backed by real-world assets.

categories.name: CHF Stablecoin
categories.content: A CHF stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Swiss Franc (CHF).

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks
categories.content: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks are on-chain proxy instruments that offer fractional exposure to private companies, allowing users to trade the value of high-growth startups before they reach public stock exchanges.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Long Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through LONG (https://x.com/longdotxyz), a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain whose defining feature is that every launch trades against a Robinhood Stock Token.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.
